description.en: Set up CodeRouter, the cmux model router, in a few steps: connect your provider accounts, share them with your team and route your agents through it. See health, usage, spend and failover order at a glance, create API keys and send a test request. Your keys and sign-ins stay with cmux; this app never sees them.
description.ja: cmux のモデルルーター CodeRouter を数ステップで設定: プロバイダーのアカウントをつなぎ、チームと共有して、エージェントを CodeRouter 経由で動かします。状態、使用量、費用、フェイルオーバー順をひと目で確認し、API キーの作成やテストリクエストの送信もできます。キーとサインイン情報は cmux が保持し、このアプリが見ることはありません。

tagline.en: Connect your model accounts and route your agents through CodeRouter
tagline.ja: モデルのアカウントをつなぎ、エージェントを CodeRouter 経由で動かします

scopes.coderouter:read: See whether CodeRouter is healthy, which accounts are connected, the names of your API keys, your usage and the failover order. It never sees a key or token.
scopes.coderouter:write: Ask cmux to connect, share or remove an account and to send your agents through CodeRouter. cmux asks you first and keeps the secret.
scopes.actions:run: Open the Accounts screen and sign-in windows, and start a provider's own login when you click.

optionalScopes.coderouter:execute: Send one tiny test prompt through CodeRouter when you click Test. It uses a few tokens.
optionalScopes.coderouter:keys: Create and revoke CodeRouter API keys. cmux shows a new key once in its own window; this app never sees it.

statusShowsUsage.title: Show today's spend in the status item
